basis.colour: DESIGN CHOICE from the merged segment design (workflow wf_87c8ab5d-bf0, 19 October 2026). Charcoal, lime, silver foil and paper. Not verified brand colours; no foil swatch matched.
basis.type: ASSUMPTION (design choice). Sarabun is our choice; the organiser's typeface was not read (48 section 5.1). Sizes, weights and line heights are ASSUMPTION.
basis.layout: ASSUMPTION (design choice). The grid, gutters and bands are ours (48 section 5.5).

layout.grid: Pack front: 12 columns over a 62 mm live width (4 mm side margins), column 3.33 mm. Web: 12 columns at desktop width.
layout.gutter: Pack front: 2 mm. Web: 24 px at desktop width, 16 px side gutter at phone width with no horizontal scroll.
layout.bands: Pack front: top band about 8 mm for the name line; middle band for the cube; bottom band for particulars and placeholders.

cube_side.basis: ASSUMPTION (derived design value), basis B (user, 19 October 2026; rework/64 section 8). Mass is DERIVED on ASSUMPTION inputs: 2.944 g of reactants per 330 ml at 0.55 volume, pH 3.5 (potassium bicarbonate 0.811 g; citric acid 2.10 g total, of which 0.519 g stoichiometric and 1.581 g free excess; sucralose 33 mg), plus 0.80 g binder and filler (ASSUMPTION, range 0.5 to 1.2 g) and 0.05 g lime flavour powder (ASSUMPTION, range 0.02 to 0.10 g). Central cube mass 3.79 g, range 3.46 to 4.24 g. Implied density 1.38 g/cm3 at 14 mm. The density band 1.25 to 1.60 g/cm3 is ASSUMPTION; the whole mass range gives 1.26 to 1.55 g/cm3, inside it. Superseded: 15 mm at the 1.75-volume design dose (5.28 g, 1.56 g/cm3).

pack_w.basis: ASSUMPTION (design choice). Front 70 x 90 mm = 63 cm2, under the 80 cm2 limit for format 1.3 (Notification 445 Annex 1). No pouch converter quote. Fallback 80 mm width (72 cm2) if the name line does not fit.

pack_h.basis: ASSUMPTION (design choice), as pack_w. Seal allowance is ASSUMPTION.

pack_d.basis: ASSUMPTION: 20 mm pouch depth. The basis B cube of 14 mm plus about 2.5 mm of film and seal allowance per face gives 19 mm, which fits inside 20 mm (rework/64 section 8). No film, seal or sealant specification is sourced.

net_weight_g.basis: PLACEHOLDER, not a figure. Net weight is not printed until a cube is weighed (rework/52 section 6 item 9). The derived central cube mass is 3.79 g (basis B, rework/64 section 8, DERIVED on ASSUMPTION inputs); it is not the label value. Superseded: the 5.3 g of the 1.75-volume design (rework/48 section 6.1).

held_back: Any sugar wording (sugar-free, zero sugar, no added sugar, low sugar, sugarless): settled rule S1.
Sodium-free, low sodium, no sodium, salt-free: pending the Thai text check and a water basis.

Sodium figure (under 5 mg) and potassium amount (317 mg per serve at 0.55 volume, DERIVED from basis B, rework/64 section 8; the earlier 1,007 mg at 1.75 volumes is superseded), still held as a placeholder until the salt choice is fixed and an adviser decides whether a bare figure triggers the full nutrition panel. The potassium presence line is printed as a plain fact; its amount is a placeholder.
Total sugars 0 g panel line: held with the panel; an adviser must confirm it does not read as a sugar-free claim (S1).
Potassium benefit (muscle, heart, hydration, electrolyte) and source-of-potassium wording: rules 2 and 3.
Health or function wording (hydration, immunity, energy, digestion, healthy): rule 2.
Fizz wording (fizz, fizzy, sparkling, effervescent, bubbles, releases CO2) and bubble imagery: not measured (S2).
Calorie wording (low calorie, zero calorie): no energy value sourced.

Alcohol cues (cocktail, mocktail, gin, spritz, tonic, beer, bar, happy hour), amber or gold liquid, bottle shapes, glassware, bar settings and night-out scenes: excluded on every occasion (working note 03).

Royal insignia and the organiser's public sparkling product name: not used. The SINGHA name and lion emblem are used on the proposal under the user's authorization of 18 October 2026 (rework/54, authorization section).
Organiser campaign taglines and campaign artwork: not reused, not paraphrased.
Lab-tested, clinically tested, patented, approved, certified or Thai FDA approved wording: S2, S3, G5.
Novelty wording (first, new, world-first, innovative): rule R5.
Lime fruit imagery or made-with-real-lime wording: no juice in the formulation (Notification 450 clauses 4(1) and 4(3)).
Natural flavour claim: pending the Thai text and a flavour origin; shown only as a bracketed choice.
Recyclable, compostable or plastic-free pouch wording: no source (D-P1).
Vegan, halal, gluten-free, keto or any certification: no source.
Trade mark symbol or registered-mark text: trademark status not checked, so no mark is shown.
Launch price, sales channel and can size: the organiser's launch facts, not this product's facts.

type_system.display: Georgia Bold, caps, for the product name. Free fallback: Gelasio Bold (metric-compatible). Georgia is taken as installed on target machines and is not checked there.
type_system.text: Leelawadee UI Regular and Bold for all copy, with bold caps for the descriptor. Free fallback: Noto Sans Thai. Leelawadee UI is taken as installed on target machines and is not checked there.
type_system.wordmark: The lion is the authorised SINGHA lion, recoloured and cut from the supplied artwork. The SINGHA wordmark is removed and no lettering appears beside or under the lion.
type_system.minimum_legal_size_note: Legal particulars at or above 2.2 mm (the pack-particulars size in type). The back copy is set at 2.3 mm in this layout. Check the printed size before print.
